attributes.action: Review police funding to reflect regional population changes
attributes.additional_details: Cambs and Peterborough grew by 89,683 people in 2011–2021: 11.1%, against 6.5% across England. Police grants are still based on 2011 census data. Cambs, Lincs, Wilts, Essex, Beds and Leics are the six lowest-funded forces per resident in the 2026/27 funding proposals, which we feel does not reflect current needs. Police grants are still based on formula from 2013-14, which in part uses 2001 and 2011 census data. Police need resources to tackle riots, intimidation by balaclava-clad offenders, and everyday crime and anti-social behaviour. We want a review to ensure fair funding and interim support now.
attributes.background: Review police funding to ensure it reflects current population. Publish an implementation timetable by 31 March 2027 and provide interim funding now to tackle crime and anti-social behaviour in areas whose needs we believe have significantly outgrown their allocations.
